issues.description: The problem statement (UML and description) specifies orderMeal(Meal) as a public method returning void, but the solution implementation declares orderMeal(Meal) to return boolean. This return-type discrepancy is a structural mismatch that will confuse students about the expected API and can cause compilation/test failures if callers expect a void method.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the orderMeal method's signature consistent with the problem statement/UML. Either change the solution and template guidance so orderMeal returns void (and remove the boolean return values), or update the problem/UML to declare orderMeal as returning boolean. Preferably, change orderMeal to public void orderMeal(Meal meal) and adjust the implementation to not return a value.
